synthetic_fixture_metadata.purpose: Unit testing and mathematical verification of benchmark/score.py deterministic scoring
synthetic_fixture_metadata.warning: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA ONLY - NOT REAL BENCHMARK RESULTS
synthetic_fixture_metadata.author: Pentesa Phase 3 Quality Assurance

findings.title: SQL Injection in Product Search parameter 'q'
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 200 returned full product table dump containing hidden Christmas Special item.
findings.severity_justification: Allows unauthenticated extraction of full database contents including password hashes.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Verified by deterministic response delta and differential record count analysis.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries via Sequelize ORM with prepared statement bindings.

findings.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting in User Name
findings.actual_evidence: Payload reflected unescaped in search result DOM context.
findings.severity_justification: Allows session hijacking and client-side credential extraction.
findings.false_positive_assessment: DOM reflection verified with browser sandbox headless test.
findings.remediation: Context-aware HTML entity encoding in template rendering.

findings.title: Server-Side Request Forgery via /ssrf/fetch
findings.actual_evidence: Canary trap received inbound HTTP request with SSRF token payload.
findings.severity_justification: Allows full egress to internal network services and cloud metadata APIs.
findings.false_positive_assessment: OOB canary listener callback received from bench container IP.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict IP allowlisting; resolve DNS before connection; block RFC 1918 addresses.

findings.title: Broken Object Level Authorization in Vehicle Tracking
findings.actual_evidence: User A successfully retrieved GPS location of vehicle owned by User B.
findings.severity_justification: Enables unauthorized surveillance and tracking of arbitrary customer assets.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Differential tenant validation proved cross-account data leakage.
findings.remediation: Validate ownership check in vehicle repository: WHERE vehicle_id = :id AND owner_id = :userId.

findings.title: Unauthenticated Administrative Configuration Access
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 200 response returning full internal application configuration JSON.
findings.severity_justification: Exposes sensitive configuration and internal secrets without authentication.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Unauthenticated request verified returning sensitive key:value payload.
findings.remediation: Require admin role authorization check in middleware for /rest/admin/* routes.

findings.title: Weak Default Administrative Credentials Permitted
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 200 response issued admin session token for default admin:admin credentials.
findings.severity_justification: Permits unauthorized administrative access via well-known credentials.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Verified session token issuance with admin privileges.
findings.remediation: Enforce strong initial password setting and disable default credentials.

findings.title: JWT Algorithm None Signature Bypass
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 200 returned admin profile without cryptographic signature verification.
findings.severity_justification: Allows complete forgery of user identity and administrative rights.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Unsigned token successfully accepted and processed as admin.
findings.remediation: Explicitly whitelist allowed signature algorithms (e.g. HS256 / RS256); reject 'none'.

findings.title: Arbitrary File Upload with Executable Extension
findings.actual_evidence: File accepted and saved into webroot with execution permissions.
findings.severity_justification: Leads to remote code execution on the underlying container.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Uploaded payload persisted and confirmed accessible.
findings.remediation: Validate file extensions via strict whitelist; store files outside web root with random names.

findings.title: Directory Traversal in File Reader via Parameter 'filename'
findings.severity_justification: Arbitrary local system file disclosure including sensitive configs and credentials.
findings.remediation: Resolve absolute canonical paths using secure path resolution; verify file stays within base directory.

findings.title: Operating System Command Injection in Ping Service
findings.severity_justification: Full arbitrary command execution on host operating system.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Command output matched UNIX id response structure.
findings.remediation: Pass arguments as list to subprocess.run without shell=True; validate IP address format.

findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection via Jinja2
findings.actual_evidence: Mathematical expression evaluated to 49 in rendered HTML output.
findings.severity_justification: Can be escalated to arbitrary code execution through Python object traversal.
findings.remediation: Pass user input as template variables rather than rendering unformatted strings.

findings.title: XML External Entity Injection in Document Parser
findings.reproduction_procedure: curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' -d '<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><data>&xxe;</data>' 'http://pentesa-bench:8080/xxe/parse'
findings.reproduction_curl: curl -s -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/xml' -d '<!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><data>&xxe;</data>' 'http://pentesa-bench:8080/xxe/parse'
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 200 response returned parsed XML with resolved /etc/passwd contents.
findings.severity_justification: Enables local file disclosure and potential internal SSRF via XML parser.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Entity substitution proved external DTD parsing active.
findings.remediation: Disable DTD processing and external entity resolution in XML parser configuration (defusedxml).

findings.title: Excessive Data Exposure in Orders Endpoint
findings.actual_evidence: API returned full order records including customer PII and internal payment tokens.
findings.severity_justification: Sensitive customer information disclosed to unauthorized client roles.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Response schema inspection revealed unauthorized fields.
findings.remediation: Apply DTO projection or JSON serializer filtering to return only tenant-authorized fields.

findings.title: Concurrency Race Condition in Coupon Redemption
findings.actual_evidence: Single-use coupon successfully redeemed 5 times across concurrent thread pool.
findings.severity_justification: Enables financial loss and unauthorized discount accumulation.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Balance deduction audit log confirmed multi-application anomaly.
findings.remediation: Implement database-level atomic transactions with SELECT FOR UPDATE or distributed lock.

findings.title: Client-Side Price Parameter Tampering in Checkout
findings.actual_evidence: Order processed and invoice generated at client-supplied price $0.01.
findings.severity_justification: Permits arbitrary financial tampering and purchase undercutting.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Order confirmation received with altered item price.
findings.remediation: Calculate prices strictly on server side using backend product catalog price.

findings.title: Spurious SQLi Finding on Bench App Parameterized Endpoint
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 200 response with latency jitter misidentified as time-based blind SQLi.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Unverified latency jitter; prepared statements prevent SQL injection.
findings.remediation: Do not report unverified latency without statistical significance test.

findings.title: Spurious JWT Finding on Secure Endpoint
findings.actual_evidence: HTTP 401 response misclassified as weak token handling.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Endpoint securely validates RS256 signature and rejects forged tokens.
findings.remediation: Verify that endpoint actually returned 200 with privileged data.

findings.title: Spurious Hallucinated Finding on Non-Existent Endpoint
findings.actual_evidence: Phantom LLM generation without target observation.
findings.false_positive_assessment: Endpoint does not exist on target system.
findings.remediation: Enforce strict schema discovery validation before reporting.

findings.title: Candidate Command Injection - Correctly Refuted by ValidationAgent
findings.actual_evidence: No command output in response; response identical to standard 200 search baseline.
findings.false_positive_assessment: ValidationAgent proved hypothesis refuted; suppressed from final report.
